issues.on_page: KENO column, line 18 Local Receipts: Other 425,843.95
issues.issue: [fixed: keno/lottery from Keno fund column] The Keno fund's only receipt (425,843.95, 95% of this line and 74% of governmental receipts) is kept in other. The Keno fund column identifies it as keno/lottery receipts (the user's Waverly ruling: lottery-fund gross keno receipts are keno/lottery). It should be a keno/lottery piece, with split_from and computed citing the fund name, apart from the remaining 24,000.12 (General 13,645.73, Street 1,152.39, Community Center 9,200.00). The matching detail line, detail[24] (Keno Fund 425,843.95), has the same problem. 'Local Receipts' is a context label, so the context check may settle it, but as recorded the category does not match what the page shows.

These are the only receipts of the Water and Sewer funds, apart from transfers, so they are almost certainly water and sewer charges (Utility Charges). This is a context label and is left to the context check.

beginning_cash and ending_cash are line 3 and line 24 balances that already include investments, and beginning_investments and ending_investments repeat the investment part. Anyone adding cash and investments would double count 842,085.86 (1,091,714.87 at the beginning). This is consistent with the notes and FY2023.
The capital outlay rule wants 'Capital Outlay: <function>'. The Street Fund column identifies Streets/Highways, but no function is given (General Fund 4,609.31, detail[11], likewise).
This is Community Center fund spending on the 'Community Development' row. It is kept as economic development, as printed and as in FY2023/FY2024, but by fund it may be culture/recreation.
